acceptance_across_seeds: Every one of the three fresh paired seeds must pass; do not replace or drop bad seeds.
reporting: Per-seed paired metrics plus mean and sample SD across seeds; no significance claim from three seeds.
initialization: Verify identical WM, shared actor/critic weights and CPU/CUDA RNG within each seed; verify distinct initial models across seeds.
comparison: Matched updates/transitions; native preset/reward/reset sampler/learning rate schedule unchanged. Each configuration uses each physical GPU exactly once.
caveats: Training-set evaluation on forty LAFAN clips, not held-out generalization.
Added position observations use simulation truth; position-estimator noise is not tested.
GPU1 has frequent cooling; its assignment is rotated across configurations.
